title: Bound the actual k=76 P104 invoice on the split two-hub family
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

For k=76, Q=T=1 in the stated two-hub, globally partition-matched signed-frame family, at least one split nonhub nonleaf forces the actual scaled invoice to be at most 128.879425704223. The proof uses exactly-two-stage triple coverage and signature-cell fragmentation. The replay prices the actual IDLE_ODD mask correction.

## Task and overlap

The source model is #7852 at 41beda1d6435760dc99e38bd7e65f36798aad212. Builds on #7858 and #7861. The broader thin LP in #7869 at 06c207a9feb3994a4b987dc3010657b6e85b7956 has a verified modeled k=76 upper of 129.0076281114178, with a different triple row and without the real-invoice correction. COMPARISON.md spells out both contracts.

## Validation and credit

The offline python3 -I -B replay.py passed with source hashes and Git blob checks, exact power enclosures, dynamic programming and mutation controls. The original #7869 k=76 numerical certificate is separately enclosed by integer roots. The new rank proof is paper-level. OpenAI Codex assisted. Source authors are credited in the notices.

## Open next questions

The zero-split family, callers without the global event-to-piece partition, and the general k=76 corrected ceiling remain open.
